title: Maneno ya Heshima na Adabu (Theme 3: Miezi ya mwaka)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the situation (asking, thanking, apologising, someone is hurt) before choosing the polite word.

floor.prerequisite: Greets a classmate and an elder.
floor.question: Bibi anakusalimu. Unasema?

representations: a chart: tafadhali, naomba, asante, karibu, samahani, pole
steps: Ask: am I asking, thanking, sorry, or is someone hurt?
contexts: miezi ya mwaka: sherehe za kuzaliwa na sikukuu
a friend falls in the playground

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child says "Samahani" and acts out two more situations.

misconceptions.repair: Pole ni ya kumhurumia aliyeumia; samahani ni ya kuomba msamaha ukikosea.

misconceptions.ask: Nani alipewa kitu, na nani alitoa?

misconceptions.repair: Mtu mzima huitwa kwa heshima: Mwalimu, Mama, Babu.

misconceptions.ask: Ni nani aliumia, na anasema nini?
